akiec.name: Actinic Keratosis / Bowen's Disease
akiec.description: Sun-induced pre-malignant cutaneous lesion that can develop into invasive squamous cell carcinoma.

bcc.name: Basal Cell Carcinoma
bcc.description: The most prevalent malignant skin neoplasm; slow-growing and destructive locally, rarely metastasizes.

bkl.name: Benign Keratosis-like Lesions
bkl.description: Harmless skin growths including seborrheic keratoses, solar lentigines, and lichen-planus-like keratoses.

df.name: Dermatofibroma
df.description: Benign fibrous histiocytoma presenting as a firm, hyperpigmented dermal nodule, typically on limbs.

mel.name: Melanoma
mel.description: Highly aggressive malignancy arising from melanocytes; rapid diagnosis and surgical excision are imperative.

nv.name: Melanocytic Nevus
nv.description: Common benign proliferations of pigment-producing melanocytes; generally benign but monitored for changes.

vasc.name: Vascular Lesion
vasc.description: Benign cutaneous vascular proliferations including cherry angiomas, angiokeratomas, and pyogenic granulomas.
